title: Technology Sector Update for 08/24/2018: SPLK,ADSK,HPQ - Nasdaq.com
text:

Technology stocks were firming in recent trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding nearly 0.9% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index gained almost 1.4%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
+ Splunk ( SPLK ) surged Friday, climbing almost 9%, after the "big data" analytics company reported Q2 sales beating Wall Street expectations, issued sales guidance for the current quarter exceeding analyst projections and raised its FY18 revenue forecast above Street views. Q2 sales grew 39% over year-ago levels to $388.3 million and topped the Capital IQ consenus for the three months ended July 31 by $29.8 million. It also is expecting between $430 million to $432 million in Q3 sales and increased its FY18 sales outlook by $40 million over its prior view to around $1.69 billion, surpassing the analyst mean by at least $2.5 million and $30 million, respectively.
In other sector news:
+ Autodesk ( ADSK ) rolled to a nearly 8% gain on Friday after the automated design software firm swung to a non-GAAP Q2 profit of $0.19 per share, reversing an $0.11 per share net loss last year and beating the Capital IQ consensus by $0.03 per share. Revenue rose to $611.7 million from $501.8 million in the year-ago period, also surpassing the $600 million analyst mean.
- HP ( HPQ ) slid almost 4% lower on Friday after saying it sees non-GAAP FY18 net income in a range of $2.00 to $2.03 per share, lagging the Capital IQ consenus by at least $0.01 per share. The weaker-than-expected forecast upstaged improved fiscal Q3 financial results, with the computer manufacturer reporting adjusted net income of $0.52 per share in the May-to-July period compared with $0.43 per share in the year-ago quarter while revenue rose 11.4% to $14.6 billion. Analysts, on average, had been expecting HP to earn $0.51 per share on $14.29 billion in sales.
